Summary: Security researchers from Eye Security executed an operation to remotely disable a vulnerable background updater associated with the abandoned Popcorn Time application. Original Article Title: Linux Kernel TCP Flaw With 9.8 CVSS Score Affects Ubuntu, Red Hat and Other Distributions
Summary: A vulnerability in the Linux kernel's IPv4 implementation allows for a race condition where inet_opt and ireq_opt are freed prematurely. This occurs because tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock transfers ownership of request socket options to a child socket without proper synchronization, potentially leading to use-after-free scenarios during concurrent SYNACK processing.
